## Description

<!-- What does this change fix or add, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Build / CI

## Areas affected

- [ ] Agent core (`packages/agent-core`) or daemon (`apps/daemon`)
- [ ] Main process / preload (`apps/desktop/src/main`, `apps/desktop/src/preload`)
- [ ] Renderer (`apps/web`)
- [ ] Shared contract (`packages/shared`)
- [ ] Packaging / release
- [ ] Other:

## Checklist

- [ ] `vp check` passes
- [ ] `vp run -r build` passes
- [ ] Tried the change in the running app (`vp run dev`)
- [ ] Changeset added in `.changeset/` (not needed for docs, CI, or internal-only changes)
- [ ] README or docs updated if behaviour changed
